_comment: Per-file line cap for hand-written code modules, enforced by the harness (PreToolUse block) and `interlinked verify` (large_files check). `files` grandfathers offenders (repo-relative path -> recorded line count): a listed file may shrink or hold, but the harness blocks any edit that grows it and verify fails it. Ratcheted 1500 -> 1000 on 2026-06-01 after decomposing the over-cap modules (the 1000-line tranche). Remaining entries are in-flight decompositions; remove each entry once its file drops below max_lines (pre-tool.ts was split into pre-tool.ts + pre-tool-helpers.ts on 2026-06-02). To tighten further (1000 -> 800 -> 500), lower `max_lines` as the list empties — the fine-grained complexity/cyclomatic checks do the sub-1000 'is this file actually bad' work. Policy: src/harness/large-file-policy.ts.
